item.title: Rage-giving, innovation and cuts: How public media has survived without federal funds
item.description: A year after President Trump signed a law ending six decades of federal funding of public media, it's a time of reinvention, innovation and clear anxiety.

item.title: Lebanese displaced by war turn to satellites to check their homes
item.description: Unable to return home, some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion of southern Lebanon are buying satellite images to see whether their houses survived.

item.title: U.S. and Iran both pause attacks for a second consecutive day
item.description: The United States and Iran both halted military strikes for a second day on Sunday, as diplomatic efforts to de-escalate continued.

item.title: ADHD presents differently in women, leading to unique health risks
item.description: Once considered a childhood disorder mainly affecting boys, ADHD is now understood to manifest differently in women, yet many still go undiagnosed.
